case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4822 OF 2022 (@SLP (C) NO. 17539 OF 2016)
summary: Duty Drawback/DEPB receipts eligibility under Section 80-IB; standard: 'derived from' requires first-degree nexus with industrial undertaking; Liberty India precedent limits exemptions to direct business operations; Meghalaya Steels distinguished as addressing subsidies reimbursing manufacturing costs; DEPB/Duty Drawback held indirect incentives under Customs Act 1962; disallowance of deductions confirmed; impugned High Court judgment upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment allowing Revenue's appeal confirmed; deductions disallowed.
